state.purpose: Blind stability test A for the current top economic-event candidates. Optimize for highest realized owner hourly earnings reached as quickly as possible.

candidates.name: procurement-renewal-watch
candidates.claim: A company with recurring SaaS/vendor renewals uploads a fixed renewal-calendar file plus contract/quote facts. The engine automatically creates 90/60/30-day renewal jobs and returns a standardized evidence-backed action: renew, cancel, downgrade, consolidate, re-quote, or investigate. Insufficient evidence returns NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE. Customer executes every procurement action. Final action and final annualized spend are returned through a fixed readback. One paid renewal trial converts to prepaid monthly monitoring. Standard runs require no owner review.

candidates.name: AI-profitability-gate
candidates.claim: An AI product company exports existing LLM/agent traces with provider, model, usage cost, workflow identity and its own accepted-outcome count. The engine reports cost per accepted outcome, margin-risk bands, and standardized keep, investigate, reprice, optimize, or retire recommendations. It does not replace observability, route traffic or change production. Customer executes every effect. One paid snapshot converts to recurring monitoring. Standard runs require no owner review.

candidates.name: cloud-cost-watch
candidates.claim: A cloud-using company provides recurring read-only billing exports. The engine detects spend anomalies, idle/waste patterns, cost concentration and quantified savings opportunities and returns a prioritized action list. It does not execute infrastructure changes. Customer executes every effect. One paid snapshot converts to recurring monitoring. Standard runs require no owner review.

candidates.name: M&A-screening-watch
candidates.claim: An M&A advisor supplies its own approved target universe plus acquisition mandate. The engine automatically ranks and screens that universe and returns evidence-backed target memos on recurring capacity. It does not source from a proprietary database, contact targets, negotiate, perform DD, or act as intermediary/FA. Customer executes every deal effect. Standard runs require no owner review.

constraints: No full platform build before paid evidence.
First paid test uses exported files where possible.
